question: According to NITI Aayog's Multidimensional Poverty Index (MPI) 2021, which among the following was the poorest state in the country?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bihar.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Multidimensional Poverty Index **(MPI) is an international measure of **acute poverty** that assesses the various dimensions of poverty, such as **health, education, and standard of living.**
 
• As per the latest MPI report released by** NITI Aayog, Bihar** has the highest incidence of multidimensional poverty in I
